verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It derives the class equation from the conjugation action, shows that every noncentral conjugacy class has size divisible by p, concludes that |Z(G)| is divisible by p, and then uses the identity element and p >= 2 to obtain a nonidentity central element. The statement is self-contained, all hypotheses are used, and there are no external references or prohibited justification patterns.
